releases.notes: Paired boards show their advertised name and the same four-character ID on Android and iOS when used with firmware 1.0.4. Bluetooth pairing gives you more time after button confirmation, and Android gives clearer help when a saved pairing needs to be renewed.

See what’s new after app updates and before installing board firmware. Choose which notices to show. Duck Chess hints now show where to move your piece, then where to place the duck. New Bluetooth pairing instructions help you reconnect your board.

Follow your game on the Play screen and replay saved games move by move. Adjust your Litch board’s lighting and computer difficulty. In Litchcraft, draw pictures and animations, then send them to your board.
